cards.text: Last time, Joab, who led David's troops, killed Abner in Hebron (2 Samuel 3:23, 27). Abner was the commander of the army of Saul, Israel's late king, and he made Saul's son Ish-bosheth king over Israel (2 Samuel 1:4; 2:8-9). Now that news is headed straight for Ish-bosheth, and friend, this is NOT a "good morning" text.

cards.question: Ish-bosheth son of Saul hears that Abner has died in Hebron. How does he take it?
Ish-bosheth is the only one in Israel who is shaken by the news about Abner.

cards.text: Saul's son has two men who lead raiding parties: Baanah and Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite. Hang on to those names, friend, because this chapter is about to be ALL about them.

cards.question: Which tribe are Baanah and Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, from?

cards.text: Then the writer leans over with a side note: Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin, because the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have lived there as foreigners to this day. Even the Bible pulls over to give directions, and friend, I RESPECT that.

Hold that thought on the brothers, friend, because the writer just hit PAUSE to tell us about Saul's grandson, the son of Jonathan. The boy was five years old when the report about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel, and his nurse picked him up and fled.

cards.question: As the nurse hurries to escape with Jonathan's five-year-old son, what happens to the boy?

answers.text: He is captured on the road
He is left behind in Jezreel

cards.question: Jonathan's son, the boy who fell, is named ___.

cards.text: And we're BACK to Rechab and Baanah. The brothers set out and show up at Ish-bosheth's house in the heat of the day, and friend, I've got a bad feeling about this.

cards.question: Rechab and Baanah arrive in the heat of the day, while the king is taking his midday ___.
Rechab and Baanah walk into the interior of Ish-bosheth's house like they're just there on a supply run. How do they get in?

answers.text: As if to get some wheat
As if to bring him a report
As if to guard his room

cards.text: Inside, they stab him in the stomach, the same way Joab killed Abner (2 Samuel 3:27). Then Rechab and his brother Baanah just... slip away.
Rechab and Baanah went in while Ish-bosheth was lying on his bed. After they killed him, they took something that would show anyone, no doubt about it, that he was dead.

cards.question: What do Rechab and Baanah take from Ish-bosheth?
Rechab and Baanah travel all night by way of the Arabah and bring Ish-bosheth's head to David, who reigns as king over Judah (2 Samuel 2:4), at ___.

cards.text: They tell the king, "Here is the head of Ish-bosheth son of Saul, your enemy who sought your life." I bet these two think they're about to be named employees of the month.

cards.question: Rechab and Baanah tell David what the LORD has done for him today. What do they say?

answers.text: Granted him vengeance on Saul's family
Paid him back for Abner's death
Given him peace with all of Israel

cards.text: But David answers them with an oath, by the LORD who has redeemed his life from all distress. Friend, that is NOT how an "attaboy" starts.

cards.question: David reminds Rechab and Baanah of the man who told him Saul was dead and thought he was bringing good news. David says he rewarded that man with a gift.

cards.text: David seized that man and put him to death at Ziklag. And David says it plain: "That was his reward for his news!"

cards.question: David tells Rechab and Baanah that wicked men have killed a ___ man in his own house and on his own bed.

cards.text: David says he will require Ish-bosheth's blood from their hands. So David commands his young men, and they kill Rechab and Baanah, cut off their hands and feet, and hang their bodies by the pool in Hebron.

cards.question: What do David's young men do with the head of Ish-bosheth?

answers.text: Bury it in Abner's tomb in Hebron
Return it to Mahanaim for burial
Hang it by the pool in Hebron

cards.text: Saul's son is gone. But keep your apron on, friend, because this story's not done baking.
